
## Setup

On the `vault-0` instance run the following command
```shell
vault operator init \
    -recovery-shares=4 \
    -recovery-threshold=2 \
    -recovery-pgp-keys="keybase:donchangfoot,keybase:cairin,keybase:adrianhopebailie,keybase:matdehaast"
```

On the other `vault` instances run the following
```shell
vault operator raft join http://vault-0.vault-internal:8200
```

Current outputs of the recovery keys. Maps to the Keybase values above.
```shell
Recovery Key 1: 
Recovery Key 2: 
Recovery Key 3: 
Recovery Key 4: 
```

To decode in cli
```shell
echo $KEY | base64 --decode | keybase pgp decrypt
```
